findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 13 (section.worker-tree: flex:1; min-height:120px; overflow:auto) and line 209 (section.worker-tree markup); /Users/mckerracher.joshua/Code/agent-orch-run/docs/ui/wireframe.md line 292 (tree "scrolls independently")
findings.evidence: app/workstreams.populated.desktop: tree rows 'Docs refresh' (y 787, h 28) and 'Build infrastructure' (y 815, h 46). Hit-test of a 9x3 grid over each row: 0% of points reach the row. Covering elements: BUTTON.ui-theme-toggle (16 of 27 points), SPAN (10), P.ambient-note (18). nav 'Workstreams' box 16,484,181x258 computed overflow:visible, height 257.5 px (fixed, no own scroll). aside.shell-sidebar clientHeight 765 equals scrollHeight 765, so the sidebar cannot scroll the rows into view. app/workstreams.populated.tablet (960x900): row 2 at y 887 is 9 of 27 points under the sidebar section; row 3 at y 915 is off-screen; sidebar clientHeight 749 equals scrollHeight 749. findings.suspected_root_cause: Hypothesis: the workstream nav in the shell sidebar has a fixed height and overflow:visible, so it does not scroll itself, and the shell's bottom Appearance block (shell-bottom, y 742) and the theme toggle overlap the spill-over rows. The wireframe gives the tree flex:1 with overflow:auto. Likely files: apps/desktop/src/ui/shell/WorkstreamTree.tsx, apps/desktop/src/ui/shell/SidebarNav.tsx, apps/desktop/src/ui/shell/shell.css (sidebar flex column).

findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html CSS .graph-text{display:none} above 760 px (text fallback only in the mobile block); the wireframe uses tabs instead of section headings
findings.evidence: app/workstreams.populated.desktop: a collapsed disclosure 'Dependencies as text 2' under the graph at all widths; section headings 'Objectives', 'Task dependencies' and 'Tasks' (ui-panel-header). The wireframe shows the text fallback only at 760 px and has no such headings. Looks tidy and does not break the layout.
findings.justification: Spec: /Users/mckerracher.joshua/Code/agent-orch-run/docs/ui/wireframe.md line 297 (text fallback under 761 px) and OX-W4 line 379 (equivalent predecessor/readiness table required). Text at desktop is an accessibility addition the spec does not forbid.

findings.title: Acceptance gate list under each objective (verified / pending / failed chips)
